trenvx.caveat: Guest file-LRU excludes DAX filesystem content. Host image/snapshot cache remains separately reported; no direct memory-saving comparison with AgentENV.

units.time: nanoseconds; host and guest clocks separate

limitations: Only internal PG_lru bit 4 defines the new file-LRU scope. Historical bit-5 points fail this scope check; raw receipts remain unchanged.
Mode-zero inodes are untyped. Regular-file pages are not all byte-verified or attributed to task paths.
Host provider/metadata/shared-layer ownership and non-LRU file coverage are incomplete. Do not treat guest file-LRU as DAX content.
New inspection has explicit pause/read costs; no matched performance pair for this variant.
DAMON reclaim is enabled in actual boot config; its causal effect was not isolated.

trenvx_early_failure.stage: kernel configuration path before frozen replay
trenvx_early_failure.reason: Actual kernel is a run-owned template alias, not the fixed global filename; hash verification was not reached.
